comparison.limits: Development seed 101 only; 3M budgets are shorter than the paper protocol. No claim of final improvement or historical parity.

concurrency_plan: Each algorithm chain starts afterok of its current 3s5z gamma095 run, then 8m_vs_9m, then MMM2; at most two full training jobs from this queue can run concurrently.

evaluation.selection: immutable final 3M checkpoint, never best diagnostic

runtime_basis: Current 3s5z 3M runs on same frozen source; 12h/16h requests allow larger-map simulator and inference costs. Resources4CPU/32GB/GPU1 per job.
